goal: Close the independently deployable Model Gateway Service through its own HTTP, routing, admission, and accounting authorities.
description: Verify native OpenAI and Anthropic wire compatibility, explicit Service authentication, bounded routing and admission, durable usage accounting, and a lifecycle independent from Meshrix.

acceptance_criteria.text: The standalone Service starts, serves its versioned direct-client contract, and remains independent from the Meshrix runtime.
Routing, admission, and usage accounting are separately executable evidence owned by the Service.

commit.message: feat: close standalone model gateway service

goal: Validate the neutral Meshrix adapter and mandatory dual-Gateway attachment boundary.
description: Complete this checkpoint only after the default-disabled stateless adapter exists and attached calls preserve the immutable traffic model, mandatory downstream and upstream Gateway traversal, governed execution, stable failure meaning, and complete detachment.

acceptance_criteria.text: The neutral adapter contains only an explicit service reference and bounded timeout, and an attached call traverses both selected Gateway directions without importing Service authority.
Disabling or removing the adapter leaves Meshrix and the standalone Service independently operable with no shared state or fallback path.

commit.message: test: validate model gateway adapter boundary
